claims.soundness: no forged certificate was accepted; the count of attacks that failed to falsify is reported alongside, because a battery that stops attacking also reports zero
claims.independence: two checkers, two languages, no shared code, 56/56 agree on vectors that are mostly refusals

explicitlyNotClaimed: completeness: ~11% of shots receive a degraded receipt, not a proof
novelty of the dual: the lane is adjacent-occupied (arXiv:2508.04969); the contribution is the assurance engineering
that agreement between two checkers implies correctness -- it implies the absence of a SHARED misunderstanding, which is less

unattestableFiles.why: a statement cannot carry its own digest; SHA256SUMS is written after the statement and is what covers it
